description: A workspace td cannot resolve. Every invocation exits non-zero with `database not found`, and the search fails with -32000 source_unavailable rather than returning an empty candidate list. This is the invariant the adapter exists to keep: an unreachable workspace must never be indistinguishable from a workspace with no matching issues.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
